Будет выполнено на сервере (от root): mkdir -p /opt/amnezia/traffic-stats; каждый файл пишется во временный <путь>.new, получает права и переносится на место (mv):

── /opt/amnezia/traffic-stats/collect.sh (права 0755) ──
#!/bin/sh
# amnezia-admin: сборщик статистики трафика VPN, формат v1.
# Читает счётчики wg/awg и дописывает снимок в /opt/amnezia/traffic-stats.
# Снять: amnezia-admin stats uninstall
set -u
umask 077
cd /opt/amnezia/traffic-stats || exit 1
if [ -e FULL ]; then exit 0; fi
dg=0
if [ -e daily.log ]; then dg=$(awk -v add=0 'BEGIN { g = 0 }
($1 == "D" || $1 == "N") && $2 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $2 + 0 > g { g = $2 + 0 }
END { printf "%d\n", g + add }' daily.log) || exit 1; fi
if [ ! -e snapshots.log ]; then
  printf 'H v1 %s\n' "$dg" > snapshots.log
fi
rg=$(awk 'NR == 1 { if ($1 == "H" && $2 == "v1" && $3 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && length($3) <= 15) printf "%d\n", $3; exit }' snapshots.log) || exit 1
if [ -n "$rg" ] && [ "$rg" -lt "$dg" ]; then
  rm -f snap.new
  printf 'H v1 %s\n' "$dg" > snap.new
  if ! awk 'function num(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && length(v) <= 15 }
function sig(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9A-Za-z:.+-]+$/ }
NF == 0 { next }
$1 == "S" {
  if ((NF == 4 || (NF == 6 && sig($5) && sig($6))) && num($2) && num($4) && $3 ~ /^[a-z0-9-]+$/) {
    inb = 1; bts = $2; bc = $3; bn = $4 + 0; m = 0; buf = $0; bsig = ""
    if (NF == 6 && $5 != "-" && $6 != "-") bsig = $5 " " $6
  } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "P" {
  if (inb && NF == 5 && $2 ~ /^[A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+$/ && num($3) && num($4) && num($5)) { m++; pk[m] = $2; prx[m] = $3 + 0; ptx[m] = $4 + 0; phs[m] = $5 + 0; buf = buf "\n" $0 } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "E" {
  if (inb && NF == 4 && $2 == bts && $3 == bc && num($4) && $4 + 0 == bn && m == bn) { blk(buf "\n" $0) }
  inb = 0
  next
}
{ inb = 0 }
function blk(text) { last[bc] = text }
END { for (c in last) printf "\n%s\n", last[c] }' snapshots.log >> snap.new; then
    rm -f snap.new
    exit 1
  fi
  mv snap.new snapshots.log
fi
ts=$(date +%s)
rm -f block.tmp
boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id 2>/dev/null) || boot="-"
if names=$(timeout 30 docker ps --format "{{.Names}}" 2>/dev/null); then
  :
else
  names=""
  printf '\nF %s - ps\n' "$ts" >> block.tmp
fi
all=$(timeout 30 docker ps -a --format "{{.Names}}" 2>/dev/null) || all=""
for spec in amnezia-awg:wg:wg0 amnezia-wireguard:wg:wg0 amnezia-awg2:awg:awg0; do
  c=${spec%%:*}
  r=${spec#*:}
  t=${r%%:*}
  i=${r#*:}
  found=0
  for x in $names; do
    if [ "$x" = "$c" ]; then found=1; fi
  done
  if [ "$found" = 0 ]; then
    for x in $all; do
      if [ "$x" = "$c" ]; then found=2; fi
    done
    if [ "$found" = 2 ]; then printf '\nF %s %s stopped\n' "$ts" "$c" >> block.tmp; fi
    continue
  fi
  st=$(timeout 30 docker inspect -f "{{.State.StartedAt}}" "$c" 2>/dev/null) || st="-"
  if out=$(timeout 30 docker exec "$c" "$t" show "$i" dump 2>/dev/null); then
    if blk=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk -v ts="$ts" -v c="$c" -v b="$boot" -v s="$st" 'BEGIN { FS = "\t"; n = 0; bad = 0 }
NR == 1 { next }
NF == 0 { next }
{
  if (NF < 8 || $1 !~ /^[A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+$/ || $5 !~ /^[0-9]+$/ || $6 !~ /^[0-9]+$/ || $7 !~ /^[0-9]+$/ || length($5) > 15 || length($6) > 15 || length($7) > 15) { bad = 1; exit 1 }
  n++
  p[n] = "P " $1 " " $6 " " $7 " " $5
}
END {
  if (bad) exit 1
  if (b !~ /^[0-9a-f-]+$/) b = "-"
  if (s !~ /^[0-9A-Za-z:.+-]+$/) s = "-"
  printf "S %s %s %d %s %s\n", ts, c, n, b, s
  for (k = 1; k <= n; k++) print p[k]
  printf "E %s %s %d\n", ts, c, n
}'); then
      printf '\n%s\n' "$blk" >> block.tmp
    else
      printf '\nF %s %s parse\n' "$ts" "$c" >> block.tmp
    fi
  else
    printf '\nF %s %s exec\n' "$ts" "$c" >> block.tmp
  fi
done
if [ -s block.tmp ]; then cat block.tmp >> snapshots.log; fi
rm -f block.tmp
sz=$(wc -c < snapshots.log) || exit 1
if [ "$sz" -gt 16000000 ]; then
  printf 'raw\n' > FULL
  exit 0
fi
if [ "$sz" -gt 8000000 ]; then
  ds=0
  if [ -e daily.log ]; then ds=$(wc -c < daily.log) || exit 1; fi
  if [ "$ds" -gt 30000000 ]; then
    printf 'daily\n' > FULL
    exit 0
  fi
  gen=1
  if [ -e daily.log ]; then gen=$(awk -v add=1 'BEGIN { g = 0 }
($1 == "D" || $1 == "N") && $2 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $2 + 0 > g { g = $2 + 0 }
END { printf "%d\n", g + add }' daily.log) || exit 1; fi
  rm -f daily.new snap.new
  if [ -e daily.log ]; then cat daily.log > daily.new || exit 1; fi
  if ! awk -v gen="$gen" 'function num(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && length(v) <= 15 }
function sig(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9A-Za-z:.+-]+$/ }
NF == 0 { next }
$1 == "S" {
  if ((NF == 4 || (NF == 6 && sig($5) && sig($6))) && num($2) && num($4) && $3 ~ /^[a-z0-9-]+$/) {
    inb = 1; bts = $2; bc = $3; bn = $4 + 0; m = 0; buf = $0; bsig = ""
    if (NF == 6 && $5 != "-" && $6 != "-") bsig = $5 " " $6
  } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "P" {
  if (inb && NF == 5 && $2 ~ /^[A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+$/ && num($3) && num($4) && num($5)) { m++; pk[m] = $2; prx[m] = $3 + 0; ptx[m] = $4 + 0; phs[m] = $5 + 0; buf = buf "\n" $0 } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "E" {
  if (inb && NF == 4 && $2 == bts && $3 == bc && num($4) && $4 + 0 == bn && m == bn) { blk(buf "\n" $0) }
  inb = 0
  next
}
{ inb = 0 }
function blk(text,   j, key, has, dx, dt, day, ak, k, a, nd, known, rs, gap, part) {
  blkno++
  day = int(bts / 86400)
  known = (bsig != "" && (bc in psig) && psig[bc] != "")
  rs = (known && psig[bc] != bsig)
  gap = ((bc in plast) && bts - plast[bc] > 660)
  for (j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
    key = bc SUBSEP pk[j]
    has = 0
    part = 0
    if (key in prv) {
      if (rs || prx[j] < prv[key] || ptx[j] < ptv[key]) { dx = prx[j]; dt = ptx[j]; if (gap) part = 1 } else { dx = prx[j] - prv[key]; dt = ptx[j] - ptv[key] }
      has = 1
      if (!known) hc[day SUBSEP bc]++
    } else if (bc in seen) { dx = prx[j]; dt = ptx[j]; has = 1 }
    if (has) {
      ak = day SUBSEP key
      arx[ak] += dx; atx[ak] += dt; an[ak]++; ap[ak] += part
      if (!(ak in ahs) || phs[j] > ahs[ak]) ahs[ak] = phs[j]
    }
    prv[key] = prx[j]; ptv[key] = ptx[j]; cur[key] = blkno
  }
  nd = 0
  for (k in prv) { split(k, a, SUBSEP); if (a[1] == bc && cur[k] != blkno) dl[++nd] = k }
  for (j = 1; j <= nd; j++) { delete prv[dl[j]]; delete ptv[dl[j]] }
  if (bc in seen) cov[day SUBSEP bc]++
  seen[bc] = 1
  psig[bc] = bsig
  plast[bc] = bts
}
END {
  for (ak in arx) { split(ak, a, SUBSEP); printf "D %s %s %s %s %.0f %.0f %.0f %d %d\n", gen, a[1], a[2], a[3], arx[ak], atx[ak], ahs[ak], an[ak], ap[ak] + 0 }
  for (ak in cov) { split(ak, a, SUBSEP); printf "N %s %s %s %d %d\n", gen, a[1], a[2], cov[ak], hc[ak] + 0 }
}' snapshots.log >> daily.new; then
    rm -f daily.new
    exit 1
  fi
  printf 'H v1 %s\n' "$gen" > snap.new
  if ! awk 'function num(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && length(v) <= 15 }
function sig(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9A-Za-z:.+-]+$/ }
NF == 0 { next }
$1 == "S" {
  if ((NF == 4 || (NF == 6 && sig($5) && sig($6))) && num($2) && num($4) && $3 ~ /^[a-z0-9-]+$/) {
    inb = 1; bts = $2; bc = $3; bn = $4 + 0; m = 0; buf = $0; bsig = ""
    if (NF == 6 && $5 != "-" && $6 != "-") bsig = $5 " " $6
  } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "P" {
  if (inb && NF == 5 && $2 ~ /^[A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+$/ && num($3) && num($4) && num($5)) { m++; pk[m] = $2; prx[m] = $3 + 0; ptx[m] = $4 + 0; phs[m] = $5 + 0; buf = buf "\n" $0 } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "E" {
  if (inb && NF == 4 && $2 == bts && $3 == bc && num($4) && $4 + 0 == bn && m == bn) { blk(buf "\n" $0) }
  inb = 0
  next
}
{ inb = 0 }
function blk(text) { last[bc] = text }
END { for (c in last) printf "\n%s\n", last[c] }' snapshots.log >> snap.new; then
    rm -f daily.new snap.new
    exit 1
  fi
  mv daily.new daily.log
  mv snap.new snapshots.log
fi

затем: systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl enable --now amnezia-traffic-stats.timer
Сборщик раз в 5 минут читает счётчики wg/awg (только чтение) и дописывает снимок в /opt/amnezia/traffic-stats; объём — не более 100 МБ (старые снимки сворачиваются в суточные итоги). Снять: amnezia-admin stats uninstall
--- err
Действие не выполнено: без терминала требуется флаг -yes (для скриптов).
##### uninstall notinstalled (код 0)
--- out
Сборщик не установлен — снимать нечего.
--- err
##### install -yes ok (код 0, установок 1, снятий 0)
--- out
Сейчас: не установлен (установить: amnezia-admin stats install)
Будет выполнено на сервере (от root): mkdir -p /opt/amnezia/traffic-stats; каждый файл пишется во временный <путь>.new, получает права и переносится на место (mv):

── /opt/amnezia/traffic-stats/collect.sh (права 0755) ──
#!/bin/sh
# amnezia-admin: сборщик статистики трафика VPN, формат v1.
# Читает счётчики wg/awg и дописывает снимок в /opt/amnezia/traffic-stats.
# Снять: amnezia-admin stats uninstall
set -u
umask 077
cd /opt/amnezia/traffic-stats || exit 1
if [ -e FULL ]; then exit 0; fi
dg=0
if [ -e daily.log ]; then dg=$(awk -v add=0 'BEGIN { g = 0 }
($1 == "D" || $1 == "N") && $2 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $2 + 0 > g { g = $2 + 0 }
END { printf "%d\n", g + add }' daily.log) || exit 1; fi
if [ ! -e snapshots.log ]; then
  printf 'H v1 %s\n' "$dg" > snapshots.log
fi
rg=$(awk 'NR == 1 { if ($1 == "H" && $2 == "v1" && $3 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && length($3) <= 15) printf "%d\n", $3; exit }' snapshots.log) || exit 1
if [ -n "$rg" ] && [ "$rg" -lt "$dg" ]; then
  rm -f snap.new
  printf 'H v1 %s\n' "$dg" > snap.new
  if ! awk 'function num(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && length(v) <= 15 }
function sig(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9A-Za-z:.+-]+$/ }
NF == 0 { next }
$1 == "S" {
  if ((NF == 4 || (NF == 6 && sig($5) && sig($6))) && num($2) && num($4) && $3 ~ /^[a-z0-9-]+$/) {
    inb = 1; bts = $2; bc = $3; bn = $4 + 0; m = 0; buf = $0; bsig = ""
    if (NF == 6 && $5 != "-" && $6 != "-") bsig = $5 " " $6
  } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "P" {
  if (inb && NF == 5 && $2 ~ /^[A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+$/ && num($3) && num($4) && num($5)) { m++; pk[m] = $2; prx[m] = $3 + 0; ptx[m] = $4 + 0; phs[m] = $5 + 0; buf = buf "\n" $0 } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "E" {
  if (inb && NF == 4 && $2 == bts && $3 == bc && num($4) && $4 + 0 == bn && m == bn) { blk(buf "\n" $0) }
  inb = 0
  next
}
{ inb = 0 }
function blk(text) { last[bc] = text }
END { for (c in last) printf "\n%s\n", last[c] }' snapshots.log >> snap.new; then
    rm -f snap.new
    exit 1
  fi
  mv snap.new snapshots.log
fi
ts=$(date +%s)
rm -f block.tmp
boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id 2>/dev/null) || boot="-"
if names=$(timeout 30 docker ps --format "{{.Names}}" 2>/dev/null); then
  :
else
  names=""
  printf '\nF %s - ps\n' "$ts" >> block.tmp
fi
all=$(timeout 30 docker ps -a --format "{{.Names}}" 2>/dev/null) || all=""
for spec in amnezia-awg:wg:wg0 amnezia-wireguard:wg:wg0 amnezia-awg2:awg:awg0; do
  c=${spec%%:*}
  r=${spec#*:}
  t=${r%%:*}
  i=${r#*:}
  found=0
  for x in $names; do
    if [ "$x" = "$c" ]; then found=1; fi
  done
  if [ "$found" = 0 ]; then
    for x in $all; do
      if [ "$x" = "$c" ]; then found=2; fi
    done
    if [ "$found" = 2 ]; then printf '\nF %s %s stopped\n' "$ts" "$c" >> block.tmp; fi
    continue
  fi
  st=$(timeout 30 docker inspect -f "{{.State.StartedAt}}" "$c" 2>/dev/null) || st="-"
  if out=$(timeout 30 docker exec "$c" "$t" show "$i" dump 2>/dev/null); then
    if blk=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk -v ts="$ts" -v c="$c" -v b="$boot" -v s="$st" 'BEGIN { FS = "\t"; n = 0; bad = 0 }
NR == 1 { next }
NF == 0 { next }
{
  if (NF < 8 || $1 !~ /^[A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+$/ || $5 !~ /^[0-9]+$/ || $6 !~ /^[0-9]+$/ || $7 !~ /^[0-9]+$/ || length($5) > 15 || length($6) > 15 || length($7) > 15) { bad = 1; exit 1 }
  n++
  p[n] = "P " $1 " " $6 " " $7 " " $5
}
END {
  if (bad) exit 1
  if (b !~ /^[0-9a-f-]+$/) b = "-"
  if (s !~ /^[0-9A-Za-z:.+-]+$/) s = "-"
  printf "S %s %s %d %s %s\n", ts, c, n, b, s
  for (k = 1; k <= n; k++) print p[k]
  printf "E %s %s %d\n", ts, c, n
}'); then
      printf '\n%s\n' "$blk" >> block.tmp
    else
      printf '\nF %s %s parse\n' "$ts" "$c" >> block.tmp
    fi
  else
    printf '\nF %s %s exec\n' "$ts" "$c" >> block.tmp
  fi
done
if [ -s block.tmp ]; then cat block.tmp >> snapshots.log; fi
rm -f block.tmp
sz=$(wc -c < snapshots.log) || exit 1
if [ "$sz" -gt 16000000 ]; then
  printf 'raw\n' > FULL
  exit 0
fi
if [ "$sz" -gt 8000000 ]; then
  ds=0
  if [ -e daily.log ]; then ds=$(wc -c < daily.log) || exit 1; fi
  if [ "$ds" -gt 30000000 ]; then
    printf 'daily\n' > FULL
    exit 0
  fi
  gen=1
  if [ -e daily.log ]; then gen=$(awk -v add=1 'BEGIN { g = 0 }
($1 == "D" || $1 == "N") && $2 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $2 + 0 > g { g = $2 + 0 }
END { printf "%d\n", g + add }' daily.log) || exit 1; fi
  rm -f daily.new snap.new
  if [ -e daily.log ]; then cat daily.log > daily.new || exit 1; fi
  if ! awk -v gen="$gen" 'function num(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && length(v) <= 15 }
function sig(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9A-Za-z:.+-]+$/ }
NF == 0 { next }
$1 == "S" {
  if ((NF == 4 || (NF == 6 && sig($5) && sig($6))) && num($2) && num($4) && $3 ~ /^[a-z0-9-]+$/) {
    inb = 1; bts = $2; bc = $3; bn = $4 + 0; m = 0; buf = $0; bsig = ""
    if (NF == 6 && $5 != "-" && $6 != "-") bsig = $5 " " $6
  } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "P" {
  if (inb && NF == 5 && $2 ~ /^[A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+$/ && num($3) && num($4) && num($5)) { m++; pk[m] = $2; prx[m] = $3 + 0; ptx[m] = $4 + 0; phs[m] = $5 + 0; buf = buf "\n" $0 } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "E" {
  if (inb && NF == 4 && $2 == bts && $3 == bc && num($4) && $4 + 0 == bn && m == bn) { blk(buf "\n" $0) }
  inb = 0
  next
}
{ inb = 0 }
function blk(text,   j, key, has, dx, dt, day, ak, k, a, nd, known, rs, gap, part) {
  blkno++
  day = int(bts / 86400)
  known = (bsig != "" && (bc in psig) && psig[bc] != "")
  rs = (known && psig[bc] != bsig)
  gap = ((bc in plast) && bts - plast[bc] > 660)
  for (j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
    key = bc SUBSEP pk[j]
    has = 0
    part = 0
    if (key in prv) {
      if (rs || prx[j] < prv[key] || ptx[j] < ptv[key]) { dx = prx[j]; dt = ptx[j]; if (gap) part = 1 } else { dx = prx[j] - prv[key]; dt = ptx[j] - ptv[key] }
      has = 1
      if (!known) hc[day SUBSEP bc]++
    } else if (bc in seen) { dx = prx[j]; dt = ptx[j]; has = 1 }
    if (has) {
      ak = day SUBSEP key
      arx[ak] += dx; atx[ak] += dt; an[ak]++; ap[ak] += part
      if (!(ak in ahs) || phs[j] > ahs[ak]) ahs[ak] = phs[j]
    }
    prv[key] = prx[j]; ptv[key] = ptx[j]; cur[key] = blkno
  }
  nd = 0
  for (k in prv) { split(k, a, SUBSEP); if (a[1] == bc && cur[k] != blkno) dl[++nd] = k }
  for (j = 1; j <= nd; j++) { delete prv[dl[j]]; delete ptv[dl[j]] }
  if (bc in seen) cov[day SUBSEP bc]++
  seen[bc] = 1
  psig[bc] = bsig
  plast[bc] = bts
}
END {
  for (ak in arx) { split(ak, a, SUBSEP); printf "D %s %s %s %s %.0f %.0f %.0f %d %d\n", gen, a[1], a[2], a[3], arx[ak], atx[ak], ahs[ak], an[ak], ap[ak] + 0 }
  for (ak in cov) { split(ak, a, SUBSEP); printf "N %s %s %s %d %d\n", gen, a[1], a[2], cov[ak], hc[ak] + 0 }
}' snapshots.log >> daily.new; then
    rm -f daily.new
    exit 1
  fi
  printf 'H v1 %s\n' "$gen" > snap.new
  if ! awk 'function num(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && length(v) <= 15 }
function sig(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9A-Za-z:.+-]+$/ }
NF == 0 { next }
$1 == "S" {
  if ((NF == 4 || (NF == 6 && sig($5) && sig($6))) && num($2) && num($4) && $3 ~ /^[a-z0-9-]+$/) {
    inb = 1; bts = $2; bc = $3; bn = $4 + 0; m = 0; buf = $0; bsig = ""
    if (NF == 6 && $5 != "-" && $6 != "-") bsig = $5 " " $6
  } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "P" {
  if (inb && NF == 5 && $2 ~ /^[A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+$/ && num($3) && num($4) && num($5)) { m++; pk[m] = $2; prx[m] = $3 + 0; ptx[m] = $4 + 0; phs[m] = $5 + 0; buf = buf "\n" $0 } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "E" {
  if (inb && NF == 4 && $2 == bts && $3 == bc && num($4) && $4 + 0 == bn && m == bn) { blk(buf "\n" $0) }
  inb = 0
  next
}
{ inb = 0 }
function blk(text) { last[bc] = text }
END { for (c in last) printf "\n%s\n", last[c] }' snapshots.log >> snap.new; then
    rm -f daily.new snap.new
    exit 1
  fi
  mv daily.new daily.log
  mv snap.new snapshots.log
fi

}
$1 == "P" {
  if (inb && NF == 5 && $2 ~ /^[A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+$/ && num($3) && num($4) && num($5)) { m++; pk[m] = $2; prx[m] = $3 + 0; ptx[m] = $4 + 0; phs[m] = $5 + 0; buf = buf "\n" $0 } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "E" {
  if (inb && NF == 4 && $2 == bts && $3 == bc && num($4) && $4 + 0 == bn && m == bn) { blk(buf "\n" $0) }
  inb = 0
  next
}
{ inb = 0 }
function blk(text,   j, key, has, dx, dt, day, ak, k, a, nd, known, rs, gap, part) {
  blkno++
  day = int(bts / 86400)
  known = (bsig != "" && (bc in psig) && psig[bc] != "")
  rs = (known && psig[bc] != bsig)
  gap = ((bc in plast) && bts - plast[bc] > 660)
  for (j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
    key = bc SUBSEP pk[j]
    has = 0
    part = 0
    if (key in prv) {
      if (rs || prx[j] < prv[key] || ptx[j] < ptv[key]) { dx = prx[j]; dt = ptx[j]; if (gap) part = 1 } else { dx = prx[j] - prv[key]; dt = ptx[j] - ptv[key] }
      has = 1
      if (!known) hc[day SUBSEP bc]++
    } else if (bc in seen) { dx = prx[j]; dt = ptx[j]; has = 1 }
    if (has) {
      ak = day SUBSEP key
      arx[ak] += dx; atx[ak] += dt; an[ak]++; ap[ak] += part
      if (!(ak in ahs) || phs[j] > ahs[ak]) ahs[ak] = phs[j]
    }
    prv[key] = prx[j]; ptv[key] = ptx[j]; cur[key] = blkno
  }
  nd = 0
  for (k in prv) { split(k, a, SUBSEP); if (a[1] == bc && cur[k] != blkno) dl[++nd] = k }
  for (j = 1; j <= nd; j++) { delete prv[dl[j]]; delete ptv[dl[j]] }
  if (bc in seen) cov[day SUBSEP bc]++
  seen[bc] = 1
  psig[bc] = bsig
  plast[bc] = bts
}
END {
  for (ak in arx) { split(ak, a, SUBSEP); printf "D %s %s %s %s %.0f %.0f %.0f %d %d\n", gen, a[1], a[2], a[3], arx[ak], atx[ak], ahs[ak], an[ak], ap[ak] + 0 }
  for (ak in cov) { split(ak, a, SUBSEP); printf "N %s %s %s %d %d\n", gen, a[1], a[2], cov[ak], hc[ak] + 0 }
}' snapshots.log >> daily.new; then
    rm -f daily.new
    exit 1
  fi
  printf 'H v1 %s\n' "$gen" > snap.new
  if ! awk 'function num(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && length(v) <= 15 }
function sig(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9A-Za-z:.+-]+$/ }
NF == 0 { next }
$1 == "S" {
  if ((NF == 4 || (NF == 6 && sig($5) && sig($6))) && num($2) && num($4) && $3 ~ /^[a-z0-9-]+$/) {
    inb = 1; bts = $2; bc = $3; bn = $4 + 0; m = 0; buf = $0; bsig = ""
    if (NF == 6 && $5 != "-" && $6 != "-") bsig = $5 " " $6
  } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "P" {
  if (inb && NF == 5 && $2 ~ /^[A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+$/ && num($3) && num($4) && num($5)) { m++; pk[m] = $2; prx[m] = $3 + 0; ptx[m] = $4 + 0; phs[m] = $5 + 0; buf = buf "\n" $0 } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "E" {
  if (inb && NF == 4 && $2 == bts && $3 == bc && num($4) && $4 + 0 == bn && m == bn) { blk(buf "\n" $0) }
  inb = 0
  next
}
{ inb = 0 }
function blk(text) { last[bc] = text }
END { for (c in last) printf "\n%s\n", last[c] }' snapshots.log >> snap.new; then
    rm -f daily.new snap.new
    exit 1
  fi
  mv daily.new daily.log
  mv snap.new snapshots.log
fi

OnUnitActiveSec=5min
AccuracySec=30s

[Install]

затем: systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl enable --now amnezia-traffic-stats.timer
Сборщик раз в 5 минут читает счётчики wg/awg (только чтение) и дописывает снимок в /opt/amnezia/traffic-stats; объём — не более 100 МБ (старые снимки сворачиваются в суточные итоги). Снять: amnezia-admin stats uninstall
Запись выполнена, но состояние сборщика не то: установлен не полностью или другой версии: нет таймера; скрипт другой версии (переустановить: amnezia-admin stats install)
--- err
##### install -yes ошибка (код 1, установок 1, снятий 0)
--- out
Сейчас: не установлен (установить: amnezia-admin stats install)
Будет выполнено на сервере (от root): mkdir -p /opt/amnezia/traffic-stats; каждый файл пишется во временный <путь>.new, получает права и переносится на место (mv):

── /opt/amnezia/traffic-stats/collect.sh (права 0755) ──
#!/bin/sh
# amnezia-admin: сборщик статистики трафика VPN, формат v1.
# Читает счётчики wg/awg и дописывает снимок в /opt/amnezia/traffic-stats.
# Снять: amnezia-admin stats uninstall
set -u
umask 077
cd /opt/amnezia/traffic-stats || exit 1
if [ -e FULL ]; then exit 0; fi
dg=0
if [ -e daily.log ]; then dg=$(awk -v add=0 'BEGIN { g = 0 }
($1 == "D" || $1 == "N") && $2 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $2 + 0 > g { g = $2 + 0 }
END { printf "%d\n", g + add }' daily.log) || exit 1; fi
if [ ! -e snapshots.log ]; then
  printf 'H v1 %s\n' "$dg" > snapshots.log
fi
rg=$(awk 'NR == 1 { if ($1 == "H" && $2 == "v1" && $3 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && length($3) <= 15) printf "%d\n", $3; exit }' snapshots.log) || exit 1
if [ -n "$rg" ] && [ "$rg" -lt "$dg" ]; then
  rm -f snap.new
  printf 'H v1 %s\n' "$dg" > snap.new
  if ! awk 'function num(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && length(v) <= 15 }
function sig(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9A-Za-z:.+-]+$/ }
NF == 0 { next }
$1 == "S" {
  if ((NF == 4 || (NF == 6 && sig($5) && sig($6))) && num($2) && num($4) && $3 ~ /^[a-z0-9-]+$/) {
    inb = 1; bts = $2; bc = $3; bn = $4 + 0; m = 0; buf = $0; bsig = ""
    if (NF == 6 && $5 != "-" && $6 != "-") bsig = $5 " " $6
  } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "P" {
  if (inb && NF == 5 && $2 ~ /^[A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+$/ && num($3) && num($4) && num($5)) { m++; pk[m] = $2; prx[m] = $3 + 0; ptx[m] = $4 + 0; phs[m] = $5 + 0; buf = buf "\n" $0 } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "E" {
  if (inb && NF == 4 && $2 == bts && $3 == bc && num($4) && $4 + 0 == bn && m == bn) { blk(buf "\n" $0) }
  inb = 0
  next
}
{ inb = 0 }
function blk(text) { last[bc] = text }
END { for (c in last) printf "\n%s\n", last[c] }' snapshots.log >> snap.new; then
    rm -f snap.new
    exit 1
  fi
  mv snap.new snapshots.log
fi
ts=$(date +%s)
rm -f block.tmp
boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id 2>/dev/null) || boot="-"
if names=$(timeout 30 docker ps --format "{{.Names}}" 2>/dev/null); then
  :
else
  names=""
  printf '\nF %s - ps\n' "$ts" >> block.tmp
fi
all=$(timeout 30 docker ps -a --format "{{.Names}}" 2>/dev/null) || all=""
for spec in amnezia-awg:wg:wg0 amnezia-wireguard:wg:wg0 amnezia-awg2:awg:awg0; do
  c=${spec%%:*}
  r=${spec#*:}
  t=${r%%:*}
  i=${r#*:}
  found=0
  for x in $names; do
    if [ "$x" = "$c" ]; then found=1; fi
  done
  if [ "$found" = 0 ]; then
    for x in $all; do
      if [ "$x" = "$c" ]; then found=2; fi
    done
    if [ "$found" = 2 ]; then printf '\nF %s %s stopped\n' "$ts" "$c" >> block.tmp; fi
    continue
  fi
  st=$(timeout 30 docker inspect -f "{{.State.StartedAt}}" "$c" 2>/dev/null) || st="-"
  if out=$(timeout 30 docker exec "$c" "$t" show "$i" dump 2>/dev/null); then
    if blk=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk -v ts="$ts" -v c="$c" -v b="$boot" -v s="$st" 'BEGIN { FS = "\t"; n = 0; bad = 0 }
NR == 1 { next }
NF == 0 { next }
{
  if (NF < 8 || $1 !~ /^[A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+$/ || $5 !~ /^[0-9]+$/ || $6 !~ /^[0-9]+$/ || $7 !~ /^[0-9]+$/ || length($5) > 15 || length($6) > 15 || length($7) > 15) { bad = 1; exit 1 }
  n++
  p[n] = "P " $1 " " $6 " " $7 " " $5
}
END {
  if (bad) exit 1
  if (b !~ /^[0-9a-f-]+$/) b = "-"
  if (s !~ /^[0-9A-Za-z:.+-]+$/) s = "-"
  printf "S %s %s %d %s %s\n", ts, c, n, b, s
  for (k = 1; k <= n; k++) print p[k]
  printf "E %s %s %d\n", ts, c, n
}'); then
      printf '\n%s\n' "$blk" >> block.tmp
    else
      printf '\nF %s %s parse\n' "$ts" "$c" >> block.tmp
    fi
  else
    printf '\nF %s %s exec\n' "$ts" "$c" >> block.tmp
  fi
done
if [ -s block.tmp ]; then cat block.tmp >> snapshots.log; fi
rm -f block.tmp
sz=$(wc -c < snapshots.log) || exit 1
if [ "$sz" -gt 16000000 ]; then
  printf 'raw\n' > FULL
  exit 0
fi
if [ "$sz" -gt 8000000 ]; then
  ds=0
  if [ -e daily.log ]; then ds=$(wc -c < daily.log) || exit 1; fi
  if [ "$ds" -gt 30000000 ]; then
    printf 'daily\n' > FULL
    exit 0
  fi
  gen=1
  if [ -e daily.log ]; then gen=$(awk -v add=1 'BEGIN { g = 0 }
($1 == "D" || $1 == "N") && $2 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $2 + 0 > g { g = $2 + 0 }
END { printf "%d\n", g + add }' daily.log) || exit 1; fi
  rm -f daily.new snap.new
  if [ -e daily.log ]; then cat daily.log > daily.new || exit 1; fi
  if ! awk -v gen="$gen" 'function num(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && length(v) <= 15 }
function sig(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9A-Za-z:.+-]+$/ }
NF == 0 { next }
$1 == "S" {
  if ((NF == 4 || (NF == 6 && sig($5) && sig($6))) && num($2) && num($4) && $3 ~ /^[a-z0-9-]+$/) {
    inb = 1; bts = $2; bc = $3; bn = $4 + 0; m = 0; buf = $0; bsig = ""
    if (NF == 6 && $5 != "-" && $6 != "-") bsig = $5 " " $6
  } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "P" {
  if (inb && NF == 5 && $2 ~ /^[A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+$/ && num($3) && num($4) && num($5)) { m++; pk[m] = $2; prx[m] = $3 + 0; ptx[m] = $4 + 0; phs[m] = $5 + 0; buf = buf "\n" $0 } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "E" {
  if (inb && NF == 4 && $2 == bts && $3 == bc && num($4) && $4 + 0 == bn && m == bn) { blk(buf "\n" $0) }
  inb = 0
  next
}
{ inb = 0 }

  fi
  gen=1
  if [ -e daily.log ]; then gen=$(awk -v add=1 'BEGIN { g = 0 }
($1 == "D" || $1 == "N") && $2 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $2 + 0 > g { g = $2 + 0 }
END { printf "%d\n", g + add }' daily.log) || exit 1; fi
  rm -f daily.new snap.new
  if [ -e daily.log ]; then cat daily.log > daily.new || exit 1; fi
  if ! awk -v gen="$gen" 'function num(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && length(v) <= 15 }
function sig(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9A-Za-z:.+-]+$/ }
NF == 0 { next }
$1 == "S" {
  if ((NF == 4 || (NF == 6 && sig($5) && sig($6))) && num($2) && num($4) && $3 ~ /^[a-z0-9-]+$/) {
    inb = 1; bts = $2; bc = $3; bn = $4 + 0; m = 0; buf = $0; bsig = ""
    if (NF == 6 && $5 != "-" && $6 != "-") bsig = $5 " " $6
  } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "P" {
  if (inb && NF == 5 && $2 ~ /^[A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+$/ && num($3) && num($4) && num($5)) { m++; pk[m] = $2; prx[m] = $3 + 0; ptx[m] = $4 + 0; phs[m] = $5 + 0; buf = buf "\n" $0 } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "E" {
  if (inb && NF == 4 && $2 == bts && $3 == bc && num($4) && $4 + 0 == bn && m == bn) { blk(buf "\n" $0) }
  inb = 0
  next
}
{ inb = 0 }
function blk(text,   j, key, has, dx, dt, day, ak, k, a, nd, known, rs, gap, part) {
  blkno++
  day = int(bts / 86400)
  known = (bsig != "" && (bc in psig) && psig[bc] != "")
  rs = (known && psig[bc] != bsig)
  gap = ((bc in plast) && bts - plast[bc] > 660)
  for (j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
    key = bc SUBSEP pk[j]
    has = 0
    part = 0
    if (key in prv) {
      if (rs || prx[j] < prv[key] || ptx[j] < ptv[key]) { dx = prx[j]; dt = ptx[j]; if (gap) part = 1 } else { dx = prx[j] - prv[key]; dt = ptx[j] - ptv[key] }
      has = 1
      if (!known) hc[day SUBSEP bc]++
    } else if (bc in seen) { dx = prx[j]; dt = ptx[j]; has = 1 }
    if (has) {
      ak = day SUBSEP key
      arx[ak] += dx; atx[ak] += dt; an[ak]++; ap[ak] += part
      if (!(ak in ahs) || phs[j] > ahs[ak]) ahs[ak] = phs[j]
    }
    prv[key] = prx[j]; ptv[key] = ptx[j]; cur[key] = blkno
  }
  nd = 0
  for (k in prv) { split(k, a, SUBSEP); if (a[1] == bc && cur[k] != blkno) dl[++nd] = k }
  for (j = 1; j <= nd; j++) { delete prv[dl[j]]; delete ptv[dl[j]] }
  if (bc in seen) cov[day SUBSEP bc]++
  seen[bc] = 1
  psig[bc] = bsig
  plast[bc] = bts
}
END {
  for (ak in arx) { split(ak, a, SUBSEP); printf "D %s %s %s %s %.0f %.0f %.0f %d %d\n", gen, a[1], a[2], a[3], arx[ak], atx[ak], ahs[ak], an[ak], ap[ak] + 0 }
  for (ak in cov) { split(ak, a, SUBSEP); printf "N %s %s %s %d %d\n", gen, a[1], a[2], cov[ak], hc[ak] + 0 }
}' snapshots.log >> daily.new; then
    rm -f daily.new
    exit 1
  fi
  printf 'H v1 %s\n' "$gen" > snap.new
  if ! awk 'function num(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && length(v) <= 15 }
function sig(v) { return v ~ /^[0-9A-Za-z:.+-]+$/ }
NF == 0 { next }
$1 == "S" {
  if ((NF == 4 || (NF == 6 && sig($5) && sig($6))) && num($2) && num($4) && $3 ~ /^[a-z0-9-]+$/) {
    inb = 1; bts = $2; bc = $3; bn = $4 + 0; m = 0; buf = $0; bsig = ""
    if (NF == 6 && $5 != "-" && $6 != "-") bsig = $5 " " $6
  } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "P" {
  if (inb && NF == 5 && $2 ~ /^[A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+$/ && num($3) && num($4) && num($5)) { m++; pk[m] = $2; prx[m] = $3 + 0; ptx[m] = $4 + 0; phs[m] = $5 + 0; buf = buf "\n" $0 } else { inb = 0 }
  next
}
$1 == "E" {
  if (inb && NF == 4 && $2 == bts && $3 == bc && num($4) && $4 + 0 == bn && m == bn) { blk(buf "\n" $0) }
  inb = 0
  next
}
{ inb = 0 }
function blk(text) { last[bc] = text }
END { for (c in last) printf "\n%s\n", last[c] }' snapshots.log >> snap.new; then
    rm -f daily.new snap.new
    exit 1
  fi
  mv daily.new daily.log
  mv snap.new snapshots.log
fi

── /etc/systemd/system/amnezia-traffic-stats.service (права 0644) ──
[Unit]
Description=amnezia-admin traffic statistics snapshot
After=docker.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
Nice=10
TimeoutStartSec=300s
ExecStart=/bin/sh /opt/amnezia/traffic-stats/collect.sh

── /etc/systemd/system/amnezia-traffic-stats.timer (права 0644) ──
[Unit]
Description=amnezia-admin traffic statistics every 5 minutes

[Timer]
OnBootSec=2min
OnUnitActiveSec=5min
AccuracySec=30s

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

затем: systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl enable --now amnezia-traffic-stats.timer
Сборщик раз в 5 минут читает счётчики wg/awg (только чтение) и дописывает снимок в /opt/amnezia/traffic-stats; объём — не более 100 МБ (старые снимки сворачиваются в суточные итоги). Снять: amnezia-admin stats uninstall
